items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: And Joe Strawder was on drums.

ctx.x: Yeah, she played piano. And they were sweethearts, and they eventually married. And Papa Celestin, he was there playing his beautiful sweet trumpet, you know, playing with the mute. He wasn't a hot... He played beautiful sweet trumpet. He played like first trumpet. He played beautiful melodies. And a reed section. Now, I had been hearing these Jazz bands with one clarinet. All of a sudden, I hear this full-sounding orchestra. Goddamn, they sounded good. Simon Marrero on bass, man. And they're playing. And that…

And Guy Kelly had started playing Louis Armstrong's thing. 'Everybody Loves Ma Baby' -- he played that on the trumpet. And he played 'What Did I Do To Be So Black and Blue?' [SINGS REFRAIN] And he was playing, and just like it was so easy... And he had a straw hat, and it was pulled down all around him. And he was an outstanding figure. He played so masterfully. See, these other guys, they played with the trumpet on the side of their lip or they looked like they were searching for something. Not Guy.
